instances_identity_check.name: instances_identity_check
instances_identity_check.value: length("instances"."provider") between 1 and 100 and length("instances"."provider_account_id") between 1 and 200 and length("instances"."provider_instance_id") between 1 and 200

balance_transactions_period_check.name: balance_transactions_period_check
balance_transactions_period_check.value: ("balance_transactions"."period_start" is null and "balance_transactions"."period_end" is null) or ("balance_transactions"."period_start" is not null and "balance_transactions"."period_end" > "balance_transactions"."period_start")
